resources.string: Select the folder that contains GameData and LoK.exe
Tap anywhere to open the system file picker.
That folder has no GameData folder. Pick the folder that contains GameData and LoK.exe.
That folder has no LoK.exe. Pick the game root - the folder that contains LoK.exe and GameData.
You picked GameData itself. Pick its parent folder, which also contains LoK.exe.
That GameData is incomplete: data000.cpk and data001.cpk must both be there.
Game data ready: %1$s in %2$s (%3$d files copied, %4$d already present)
Not enough free space: %1$s needed, %2$s available. Free some space, then tap to try again.
